QUOTE: "Tiers 3 and 4 accumulate, so a declared `entry_patterns` replaces only the built-in guesses and leaves Doxyfile-derived facts in place. A declaration can correct a guess but cannot remove a fact."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that stated tiers (1–2) replace while discovered tiers (3–4: target facts, ecosystem) accumulate and survive the stated ones. That is the asymmetry the item asks for.
